name: ice-hockey-site
description: Static site for the ice hockey learning corpus

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:meta && node scripts/astro.mjs dev
scripts.build: npm run clean:cache && npm run prepare:meta && node scripts/astro.mjs build && npm run index:search && npm run check:links
scripts.serve: npm run build && node scripts/astro.mjs preview --open
scripts.check: npm run prepare:meta && node scripts/astro.mjs check
